galleries.title: Current build
galleries.note: Every entry point, captured by driving the real game through player inputs. Placeholder panels are the pieces still in flight.

timeline.label: Foundation landed
timeline.detail: Zero-build ES-module engine: 60Hz fixed timestep, 320x180 layered renderer with y-sorted entities, edge-buffered input across keyboard/gamepad/touch, scene stack, procedural audio sequencer, save with migrations, and a hand-built pixel font.

timeline.label: Contracts pinned
timeline.detail: CONTRACTS.md fixed module ownership and the quality bar; art/names.js pinned every sprite name, the 18-guardian roster, the cast, and building footprints; core/bridge.js gave every cross-piece call a late-bound safe default.

timeline.label: Capture harness online
timeline.detail: tools/shoot.mjs drives the real game through player inputs and records screenshots, scene state, fps, and console errors. Full tour passes at 58fps with zero errors.

timeline.label: Five builders fanned out
timeline.detail: Art, overworld, battle, village+missions, and UI each handed to a fresh-context builder with disjoint file ownership.
